en.html:
Below my diaphragm, deep in the belly—something savage moved.

Waking. Stirring.
What had been planted in me that day.

A womb that could not exist. I imagined it.
An unborn creature that could not exist. I felt it.

Monster. That was its name.

The impossible thing seemed to be forcing its way into the world. Terrible pain. But no creature was there. No such event was taking place. Imaginary, all of it. The pain alone was real.

Ryoubu Suzukawa had no such womb. Shinkai had no such womb. No one could see this creature or touch it. Pure delusion. Nothing actually there.

Then THIS?
This enormous power, overflowing through me?

Haan. That was real!
